_why: Operator 2026-10-27 brief item 5: the ledger starts with history. The three known incidents of 2026-10-26/27, opened at their first evidence and marked fixed with refs. Applied once by `scripts/incident.py seed --file config/incident_seed_20261027.json --apply` (idempotent: a fingerprint already in the ledger is skipped). Fix refs name OPEN PRs where the fix is not yet merged; the ledger records what fixed it, the PR's own state says whether it is live.
